name: delegate_to_viktor
description: Delegate a task to Viktor, an AI employee that works inside the team's tools (Slack, integrations, files, code sandbox). Use it for multi-step or long-running work, or work that needs the team's connected systems. Returns Viktor's result as markdown and optional JSON and files. Viktor may take minutes. If the status is requires_action, Viktor needs something from you: answer by calling this tool again with the same thread_id.

task.description: What Viktor should do, with all context needed. Viktor does not see your conversation.

thread_id.description: Continue an existing Viktor thread (from a previous result) instead of starting a new one.

response_schema.description: Optional JSON Schema. When set, Viktor returns a JSON result that validates against it.

speed.description: Trade quality for latency. Default: smarter.

timeout_seconds.description: How long to wait for the result before returning status timed_out. The run keeps going. Default: 600.
